name: OrthoHarness
summary: For orthopaedic surgeons, researchers and device or AI teams: check an AI answer against the published orthopaedic evidence. A topic is counted across the JBJS journals by level of evidence; an AI answer's DOIs, PMIDs and quotes are checked against PubMed by fixed rules, in the browser, with no AI judge and nothing stored. The check runs at orthoharness.com/check and also at decisionindex.com/ortho (draft until surgeons approve the key). This name and tool are available to acquire or license (non-exclusive) for orthopaedic device and AI makers.

actions.label: Check an orthopaedic AI answer, or a topic, against the published evidence (JBJS by level of evidence; citations and quotes against PubMed; runs in the browser; nothing stored)
